Same quantity on both sides: done, result type, validity and volume of the Frenet sweep of an r=2 circle across the start of the S-curve spine through (0,0,0), (10,0,0), (20,10,0), (30,10,0) (Wire.bspline, a GeomAPI_PointsToBSpline fit), next to the corrected-Frenet volume of the same spine and profile (controlCorrectedFrenetVolume, 445.03, the section area times the spine's length; plain Frenet gives 436.40 because the curve has an inflection). The profile is built at Wire.point(at: 0) with Wire.tangent(at: 0) as its normal. The earlier profile lay in the XY plane (a circle at the origin with the Z normal), which holds the whole spine, so the sweep was degenerate (mass -6.9e-16) and the test asserted only non-nil; it now asserts non-nil, valid, SOLID and the volume within 1e-6. Bridge: Shape.pipeShell(mode: .frenet) non-nil (OCCTShapeCreatePipeShellMultiSection returns nullptr when the sweep is not done or MakeSolid fails), isValid, shapeType and Shape.volume; the control* keys are the same spine and profile in another mode. Kernel: BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipeShell with SetMode(true) (Frenet), SetTransitionMode(Transformed), Add(profile, false, false), SetIsBuildHistory(false), Build, MakeSolid, BRepCheck_Analyzer, BRepGProp::VolumeProperties; the pipeShellFrenet line of the transcript at %.17g. Doubles are compared to 1e-9 relative.

Same quantity on both sides: done, result type, validity and volume of the corrected-Frenet sweep of an r=1.5 circle across the start of the 3D spine through (0,0,0), (10,5,0), (20,-5,10), (30,0,10), next to the plain-Frenet volume of the same spine and profile (controlFrenetVolume). The profile is built at Wire.point(at: 0) with Wire.tangent(at: 0) as its normal. The earlier profile lay in the XY plane, oblique to the spine's start, and swept 84.96 where the same circle across the start sweeps 299.07; the test asserted only non-nil and now asserts non-nil, valid, SOLID and the volume within 1e-6. Bridge: Shape.pipeShell(mode: .correctedFrenet) non-nil (OCCTShapeCreatePipeShellMultiSection returns nullptr when the sweep is not done or MakeSolid fails), isValid, shapeType and Shape.volume; the control* keys are the same spine and profile in another mode. Kernel: BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipeShell with SetMode(false) (corrected Frenet), SetTransitionMode(Transformed), Add(profile, false, false), SetIsBuildHistory(false), Build, MakeSolid, BRepCheck_Analyzer, BRepGProp::VolumeProperties; the pipeShellCorrectedFrenet line of the transcript at %.17g. Doubles are compared to 1e-9 relative.

Same quantity on both sides: done, result type, validity and volume of the fixed-binormal (Z) sweep of a 5 x 3 rectangle across the start of the 3D spine through (0,0,0), (10,5,0), (20,-5,10), (30,0,10), next to the corrected-Frenet and plain-Frenet volumes of the same spine and profile (controlCorrectedFrenetVolume 634.64, controlFrenetVolume 624.29): the three modes give three volumes, so the volume names the mode (on a planar spine fixed binormal and corrected Frenet coincide). The rectangle's width runs along tangent x Z and its height along tangent x that, normalised, centred on Wire.point(at: 0) (Wire.polygon3D, closed). The earlier profile was the XY-plane Wire.rectangle(5, 3) on a straight spine along X, which lies in the plane holding the spine, so the sweep was an invalid solid of mass 0 and the test asserted only non-nil; it now asserts non-nil, valid, SOLID and the volume within 1e-6. The rectangle's corners are computed by simd on the bridge side and by gp_Vec in the probe, so the volumes agree to about 1e-12 relative (the plain-Frenet control, which is sensitive to the curve's inflection, the least). Bridge: Shape.pipeShell(mode: .fixed(binormal: Z)) non-nil (OCCTShapeCreatePipeShellMultiSection returns nullptr when the sweep is not done or MakeSolid fails), isValid, shapeType and Shape.volume; the control* keys are the same spine and profile in another mode. Kernel: BRepOffsetAPI_MakePipeShell with SetMode(gp_Dir(0, 0, 1)) (fixed binormal), SetTransitionMode(Transformed), Add(profile, false, false), SetIsBuildHistory(false), Build, MakeSolid, BRepCheck_Analyzer, BRepGProp::VolumeProperties; the pipeShellFixedBinormal line of the transcript at %.17g. Doubles are compared to 1e-9 relative.
